verdict.rationale: Metorial's own docs say teams can review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events and failures after work runs. The Agents area is documented for investigating a tool call or reviewing a session, and each environment keeps its own logs. However, the docs do not show how much detail each call record holds or that every call is captured, and nothing describes replaying a session. Missing for 10: documented per-call payload detail (arguments, results, timing), an explicit guarantee that every tool call is logged, replay capability, export or API access to logs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
